source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
Virus disease overview (ជម្ងឺគុងគ្រា): this is a general term for a group of diseases caused by viruses. There are many types of viral disease occurring in the Asian region, such as leaf mottle/mosaic diseases (referred to in the source as គៀលឡើង, គៀលញស្លឹក, គៀលស្លៅ and គៀលស្លឹកស, among others). These diseases can severely damage corn crops, particularly in areas of Asia where the crop has experienced prolonged drought/water-stress conditions over extended periods.

The source notes that this disease group has not been reported as a widespread epidemic problem in Cambodia. Symptoms of these viral diseases can resemble symptoms of nitrogen deficiency: viral symptoms tend to appear first on young leaves, whereas nitrogen deficiency symptoms tend to appear first on older leaves.
